task: Implement the canonical deterministic Constraint Planner that combines accepted Visual Authority, proven Template Genome, proven Template Type semantics and bounded Product Owner production intent into an explainable immutable production constraint plan without mutating Page Schema.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Genome and Template Type semantics are now proven, but no canonical executable authority combines them with accepted Visual Authority and Product Owner intent into bounded deterministic production constraints. Without this planner, later Media Planner and Dynamic Compiler work would each invent their own interpretation rules and reintroduce manual template-local decisions.
observableOutcomes: One versioned Constraint Planner compiles accepted Visual Authority + Template Genome + Template Type + bounded Product Owner production intent into an immutable deterministic constraint plan.

Product Owner intent can only narrow or prioritize semantic options already allowed by the selected Template Type and Genome; it cannot invent arbitrary layouts, media roles, component families or engine authorities.

The planner output contains explainable composition, density, navigation, interaction, content, commerce, media, component, engine, responsive and exclusion constraints plus source lineage and deterministic plan hash.
Generator Readiness fails closed when production intent is missing, references the wrong Visual Authority, requests unsupported semantics, or produces an invalid planner result.
The planner does not mutate Page Schema, choose concrete media, generate components or bypass canonical Builder operations.
Template #3 remains blocked by the remaining Media Planner, distinctness, lineage, dynamic compiler and VX intelligence gaps.
unresolvedRisks: If Product Owner intent is unbounded, the planner becomes a hidden freeform generator and defeats Type/Genome authority.
If planner output contains concrete component instances or page mutations, it prematurely becomes the Dynamic Compiler.
If plan identity is not deterministic, downstream lineage and evidence reuse cannot prove which constraints produced a package.
If accepted Visual Authority is represented twice, reference drift can create conflicting design owners.

in: Canonical versioned Product Owner production intent contract linked to the existing accepted visualAuthority reference key.
Deterministic constraint planning over proven Template Genome and Template Type System.
Bounded selection/priority rules for archetypes, semantic media roles, component families, density and canonical engine priorities.
Carrying existing type/genome navigation, interaction, content, commerce, responsive and exclusion semantics into explainable planner output.
Deterministic plan hash and source lineage.
Generator Readiness integration and adversarial planner proofs.
out: Page Schema mutation or component generation.
Concrete media generation/selection or asset promotion.
New Control Plane gates or parallel completion systems.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: Constraint Planner is the semantic bridge between design authorities and later compilation. It must be deterministic, immutable, fail-closed and authority-preserving because Media Planner and Dynamic Compiler will consume its output. The practical ceiling is exhaustive contract/invariant validation, bounded intent semantics, deterministic hashing, negative/adversarial proofs and Generator Readiness combination proof.

acceptanceCriteria: Constraint Planner has one canonical versioned executable contract under builder-template-system.
Planner requires accepted Visual Authority, valid Genome, valid Template Type compatibility and explicit bounded Product Owner intent.
Product Owner selections must be subsets of the Type/Genome semantic intersection where applicable.
Planner output is deterministic and deeply immutable with a stable content hash and source lineage.
Planner output carries no concrete media src/referenceSrc, Page Schema nodes or arbitrary source-code instructions.
Generator Readiness cannot be ready when planner evidence is missing or invalid.
FACTORY-CONSTRAINT-PLANNER becomes PROVEN only with implementation plus adversarial executable tests.
Remaining Brabus blockers continue to block Template #3.
invariants: Existing visualAuthority manifest remains the only accepted visual reference authority.
Template Genome remains template identity/grammar authority.
Template Type System remains reusable type semantics authority.
Product Owner intent may narrow/priority-select only; it may not expand canonical semantic authority.
Constraint Planner plans constraints only and does not emit Builder mutations or compiled pages.
Commerce truth and Runtime behavior remain in shared platform authorities.
UNKNOWN, stale, conflicting or unsupported planner input never counts as ready.

failureModes: Product Owner intent references a stale or foreign Visual Authority and planner still emits a plan.
Intent requests an archetype/media role/component family outside the Type/Genome intersection.
Intent changes engine expectations beyond the canonical Template Type definition.
Identical semantic inputs in different set ordering produce different plan hashes.
Planner output starts containing concrete Page Schema nodes or media file paths.
Constraint Planner promotion accidentally clears unrelated Template #3 blockers.
edgeCases: Mixed-density Template Type may be narrowed to sparse/balanced/dense; a fixed-density type cannot be contradicted.
Intent arrays with duplicates or alternate ordering normalize deterministically.
A valid Type System definition may exist before a Factory foundation; planner validity alone does not imply package readiness.
A Genome may be richer than the selected type; planner uses semantic intersection for selectable composition/media/components while retaining Genome-owned exclusions and responsive grammar.

alternatives.summary: Compile a bounded immutable plan from existing authorities and explicit narrow PO intent.
alternatives.reason: Preserves authority boundaries and creates a stable upstream contract for Media Planner and Dynamic Compiler.

alternatives.summary: Continue encoding production choices directly in each Factory recipe.
alternatives.reason: Would perpetuate template-local manual decisions and force Media/Compiler logic to infer intent from final implementation.

alternatives.summary: Let Product Owner provide unrestricted textual generator instructions.
alternatives.reason: Would be non-deterministic, difficult to prove, and capable of bypassing Type/Genome/Builder constraints.

specialistReviews.finding: Visual Authority manifest, Template Genome and Template Type System are already separate canonical inputs; planner should compose them rather than replace them.
specialistReviews.resolution: Planner consumes authorities by reference/value and emits only an immutable constraint artifact.

specialistReviews.finding: A stored planner artifact could become stale if source identities are not embedded and revalidated.
specialistReviews.resolution: Plan embeds visual reference, Genome hash/version, Type System contract/type and PO intent identity, then hashes normalized content deterministically.

specialistReviews.finding: Planner constraints must guide composition without turning each template type into one fixed skeleton.
specialistReviews.resolution: PO intent selects from semantic intersections and carries type/genome grammar, but no exact section tree or concrete visual assets are emitted.

specialistReviews.finding: Planner must not become a runtime behavior or commerce authority.
specialistReviews.resolution: Engine IDs are expectations only and output contains no runtime mutations, commerce state, checkout logic or Page Schema nodes.

challenge.scenario: PO intent references a different visualAuthority key than the Blueprint.
challenge.finding: A plan could be produced against the wrong approved design.
challenge.resolution: Planner fails closed on visual reference mismatch.

challenge.scenario: PO requests an archetype that exists in Type System but not in this Genome.
challenge.finding: Type-level validity could overwrite template identity.
challenge.resolution: Selectable archetypes are the Type/Genome intersection; out-of-intersection request blocks.

challenge.scenario: PO requests a semantic media role or component family outside the Type/Genome intersection.
challenge.finding: Later Media/Compiler stages could silently broaden template identity.
challenge.resolution: Planner validates required media and preferred component selections as subsets of the intersections.

challenge.scenario: PO attempts to prioritize E11 for a gaming type where E11 is not a type engine expectation.
challenge.finding: Planner could invent unsupported engine requirements.
challenge.resolution: Intent engine priorities must be subset of selected Type required/priority engine expectations.

challenge.scenario: Fixed sparse luxury type receives explicit dense density intent.
challenge.finding: PO preference would contradict reusable type semantics.
challenge.resolution: Only mixed-density types permit narrowing; fixed-density conflicts block.

challenge.scenario: Semantically identical PO sets arrive in different array order or with duplicates.
challenge.finding: Naive hashing would create non-deterministic lineage.
challenge.resolution: Set-like intent fields normalize to sorted unique lists before plan hashing.

challenge.scenario: Planner output contains media URL/path or Page Schema node-like structures.
challenge.finding: Planner would absorb Media Planner/Dynamic Compiler authority.
challenge.resolution: Planner schema contains semantic constraints only and tests reject concrete-source contamination.

challenge.scenario: Constraint Planner becomes PROVEN while Media Planner/Distinctness/Compiler remain incomplete.
challenge.resolution: Maturity promotion is capability-specific; all remaining required blockers continue to block authoring.

proofPlan: Unit/adversarial proof for deterministic normalization/hash, deep immutability and source lineage.
Fail-closed proof for missing intent, wrong visual reference, unsupported semantic selections, invalid engine priorities and density conflicts.
Boundary proof that planner output contains no concrete media paths or Page Schema/component instances.
Generator Readiness combination proof using Loot Vault v2 existing accepted Visual Authority, Genome and Type semantics.
Production maturity proof promotes only FACTORY-CONSTRAINT-PLANNER and keeps remaining Template #3 blockers.
Normal CI + exact-head Template Factory Quality Gate v2 + external proof handoff + Completion Truth + lifecycle closure.

requirements.requirement: Canonical deterministic Constraint Planner compiles accepted Visual Authority, Genome, Template Type and bounded Product Owner intent into immutable explainable production constraints.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Planner does not create a second visual, runtime, commerce, Page Schema or media authority.

requirements.requirement: Missing, stale, conflicting or unsupported planner inputs cannot satisfy Generator Readiness.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Invalid planner evidence cannot produce ready=true.

requirements.requirement: Constraint Planner completion must not promote Media Planner, Distinctness, Dynamic Compiler or Template #3 readiness.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Planner proof cannot stand in for downstream Brabus capabilities.

notes: Third Brabus hardening wave. Template Genome and Template Type System are PROVEN and lifecycle-closed. Constraint Planner is the next upstream dependency before Media Planner and Dynamic Compiler. It must remain semantic/deterministic only; Template #3 remains forbidden.
